jobs.title: Staff Product Manager [Accounting Europe] - German speaking 🇩🇪
jobs.description:
- Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qonto.com based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here https://medium.com/qonto-way/the-qonto-way-our-culture-is-our-strategy-90defd4895f9).
   
   

 - Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre https://www.linkedin.com/in/aprot/ and Steve https://www.linkedin.com/in/steveanavi/, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
   
   

 - Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process https://medium.com/qonto-way/a-recruiters-dilemma-confronting-bias-in-hiring-b78acce148eb because the best teams are built on merit.
   
   

 - AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here https://medium.com/qonto-way/ai-at-qonto-vision-statement-725a7e2f659b) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
   
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   

Join us as Staff Product Manager, Accounting Europe to make accounting simple for SMEs and accountants, whatever their setup. You'll start with Germany, then take what works to other European markets, under the guidance of Paul Mourot https://www.linkedin.com/in/paulmourot/, our Head of Product for Accounting.

 

➡️ What you'll do

 - Fix a broken experience: You'll build an accounting page that surfaces our existing building blocks and integrations, starting with Connect.

 - Live with our customers: You'll spend your time with SMEs, accountants and tax advisors to understand their habits and needs.

 - Assemble before you build: You'll combine existing building blocks to deliver value fast, and shape what we build next.

 - Define the long-term vision: You'll set the product direction for accounting in Germany, using AI to prototype and test ideas early.

 - Scale across Europe: You'll adapt the offer to each market and to every segment, from small businesses to SMEs and accountants.

 

➡️ What we're looking for

 - German fluency: You speak German natively and have strong English, so you can work with local customers and Qonto's European teams.

 - Customer obsession: You learn by talking to users, and you turn what you hear into product decisions.

 - Proven scale: You've taken a product from 0 to 1 or significantly scaled it, and you think in outcomes, not features.

 - Systems thinking: You can see which existing pieces to reuse and which to build, then make the trade-offs.

 - AI-native workflow: You use AI to speed up research, specs and prototyping, and you see it as a product lever.

 

➡️ What we can offer you

 - Local expertise on tap: Tax advisors who know the German market will support you, so you don't need to be an accountant.

 - A head start: You start with a live tax advisor marketplace and a proven French bookkeeping engine.

 - Real scope: You own accounting for every European market outside France, across segments.

 - Autonomy and AI tools: Your squad owns its roadmap and ships without red tape, with unlimited access to the best AI tools.

 

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Paul Mourot https://www.linkedin.com/in/paulmourot/, Head of Product for Accounting, who gives his PMs real ownership. Paul was CPO and co-founder at Semana, Head of Product at BCG Digital Ventures, and CPO at Tiime, an accounting-tech platform. He joined Qonto in 2025 to build the accounting product line, and he hires great people, gives them support, context and autonomy.


------------------------------------------------------------------------------


At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

MISSION

Join Qonto as Staff Product Marketing Manager for the Netherlands to take a young, high-potential market to its next stage of growth. The basics are in place: localized IBANs, accounting integrations and payment methods, and a product that's already found real fit with Dutch freelancers and SMEs.

You'll work closely with Paula Ibarra, your future manager, and Georg Nuechtern, our NL Managing Director, and you'll be part of a PMM team dedicated to making Qonto the daily finance workspace for freelancer and SMEs across Europe.


➡️ AS A STAFF PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER AT QONTO, YOU WILL

 - Close the gap between market perception and product reality: Dutch customers and competitors talk about features Qonto may already ship. Part of this role is knowing the product cold enough to catch that gap before it becomes a lost deal or a wrong roadmap bet.

 - Own the go-to-market for the Netherlands: Lead GTM end to end for a pipeline of upcoming pricing and product launches.

 - Be the voice of the Dutch market internally: Spend time with customers and prospects, understand which local gaps remain despite already-strong product-market fit, and turn that into prioritized input for the roadmap.

 - Partner cross-functionally at speed: Work inside a tribe that moves fast, run in close collaboration with Product and Tech. Bring that same collaboration to ongoing pricing experiments and acquisition partnerships.

 - Take ownership of measurable impact: Define success metrics for your initiatives and own their effect on activation, adoption, and revenue, building on a team that has hit its targets quarter after quarter.


➡️ WHAT TO EXPECT

 - Strategic market focus: The role is built around the Netherlands specifically, at an early stage of the market's life. You're joining a team that launched a year ago and was staffed within the last year.

 - Fast, test-driven culture: The team runs as a tribe, Lean-inspired, agile, constantly experimenting on pricing, incentives, and acquisition.

 - Competitive market: You'll be up against traditional Dutch banks pushing further online and after freelancers and solopreneurs, strong local neobanks, payment pure players, and non-Dutch entrants building presence through social and money transfer products.

 - High impact, high visibility: A strategic, multifaceted role with a strong business focus, positioning you as a true partner to the market's leadership.

 - Growth environment: You're joining an early-stage market with real traction and headroom, as Qonto pushes to become the daily finance workspace for SMEs, with ambitious OKRs for 2026.


➡️ ABOUT YOU

 - Fintech and market experience: Strong market and business acumen in B2B fintech or adjacent markets, ideally including firsthand knowledge of the Dutch competitive landscape.

 - Customer-centric mindset: Demonstrated ability to turn customer insight into strategy, messaging, and go-to-market execution, not just report it.

 - Collaborative strength: You influence without formal authority and build consensus across product, tech, sales, and central functions.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity: You're energized by an early-stage, still-forming market rather than needing a fully mature playbook.

 - Language: Native or fluent Dutch, with strong professional English.

Join us as a Product Manager for KYCB and help build one of the most sophisticated compliance engines in Europe.  - Own entry-into-relationship checks: You'll shape the identity, fraud, and sanctions rules that decide who becomes a Qonto customer, across countries and business types.

 - Design agentic compliance workflows: You'll build AI-driven decisioning that automates routine checks end-to-end, reserving human judgment for the cases that truly need it.

 - Modernize the onboarding stack: You'll help migrate hundreds of Ops reviewers off a legacy tool onto a new, purpose-built workflow platform.

 - Partner daily with Ops: You'll ship changes that directly shape the daily work of a large, global operations team.

 - Compliance or risk product experience: You've shipped products in KYC, AML, fraud, or another regulated domain.

 - Complex rules, made simple: You know how to translate dense regulatory logic into clear, buildable workflows.

 - Ops-first mindset: You've partnered closely with operations teams and design for the people who use your tools every day.

 - AI-native workflow: You use AI to build faster, and you're excited to design agentic workflows that automate real decisions.

 - Fluent in English: You communicate comfortably in English.

 - A domain mid-transformation: You'll join KYCB as it shifts from manual checks to agentic automation.

 - High-stakes impact: Your work will touch every Qonto customer, at every stage of their relationship with us.

 - A growing scope: As Qonto opens new markets and legal forms, your remit will keep expanding.

 - Direct access to leadership: You'll work closely with Quentin and the wider Customer Lifecycle product team on how Qonto builds trust at scale.

 


➡️ YOUR FUTURE MANAGER

You'll report to Quentin https://www.linkedin.com/in/quentin-guironnet/?locale=en, Director of Product for Customer Lifecycle.  - Communications and CRM expertise: You have worked hands-on with communication or CRM platforms such as Braze, Customer.io, or other notification or email systems, ideally across multiple tools in a real ecosystem.

Shape how Qonto connects to the rest of its customers' world by building the Public API strategy: a reliable, consistent API that powers integrations, partners, MCP and Qonto Embed, and turns connectivity into a growth engine for our all-in-one and upmarket ambitions. You will report to Fanny https://www.linkedin.com/in/fanny-laverty/, who leads Qonto Connect, and you will own the product and governance framework that every Qonto team builds on.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As Product Manager, Public API, you will:

 - Strategic ownership: Define the Public API strategy and roadmap for a product that already powers our integrations, MCP and Qonto Embed, and decide where to take it next.

 - Meaningful, high-stakes impact: Make the API a reliable foundation for connectivity, helping Connect grow for our active customers.

 - Platform thinking: Define a shared framework so that every Qonto team can build and expose its endpoints consistently, and partners can self-serve.

 - Cross-functional leadership: Partner with PMs and engineering managers across Qonto to align on priorities and get API needs onto their roadmaps.

 - Market context: The Public API is no longer just integrations. It now also powers MCP and Qonto Embed, so complexity grows fast and we need one person fully focused on its strategy.

 - Team: You join the Connect team of 3 PMs (marketplace and bank aggregation, integrations, Public API), working with an engineering team that mixes backend and low-code engineers.

 - The first question on your desk: what works well and what needs improvement in the Public API, how does each consumer of the API fit in, and what is our next bet in terms of use case tu enable and push via API.

 - Tools: You work with the public API documentation (open to partners without a Qonto account), the developer portal, and AI tools. Being comfortable opening the docs or the code is part of the job.

 - Rituals: a daily product and tech sync by scope, a Monday product weekly with peers, a Friday debrief to share wins and struggles, and a Monthly Connect showcase of results and new features.

🏅 About you

 - Experience: You have solid product management experience and are comfortable owning a product that every other team contributes to, with a roadmap you have to build and defend yourself.

 - API and technical sensitivity (a plus): You have worked on an API, integration, platform or developer-facing product, or you learn technical topics fast. You’re comfortable getting hands-on with API documentation and working closely with engineers.

 - Stakeholder management and influence: You have aligned several teams around a shared product without hierarchical authority. You communicate clearly with PMs, engineers and senior stakeholders, and you consider the impact of your plan on every team before pushing it.

 - Nice to have: Fintech, payments or partner-integration background, and curiosity for AI tools and vibe coding (we learn it together at Qonto).
